definitions: A device worn to protect a person from injury in the event of a fall, typically consisting of straps that secure around the body and attach to a lifeline or anchor point.
A system of straps and buckles designed to secure a person, often in a dangerous environment, to prevent falling or to mitigate the impact of a fall.
examples: Always wear a safety harness when working at heights.
The climber checked his safety harness before ascending.
A properly fitted safety harness is crucial for fall protection.
